title: Ocean Impact Lab reference cases v1
description: Reference-case ledger for drop, splash, float, sink, and damping behavior. The first packet combines standards, official physics references, and committed internal calibration evidence; later packets can add measured footage with the same schema.

sources.title: NIST Guide to the SI, standard acceleration of free fall
sources.usage: Standard gravity value used for free-fall and hydrostatic expected bands.

sources.title: USGS Water Science School: Water Density
sources.usage: Fresh-water density and ice/floating-density context for hydrostatic draft references.

sources.title: OpenStax University Physics: Archimedes' Principle and Buoyancy
sources.usage: Buoyancy, displaced-fluid weight, and submerged-fraction formula source.

sources.title: NASA Glenn Research Center: Drag Equation
sources.usage: Quadratic drag variables used by the terminal-velocity reference case.

sources.title: NASA Glenn Research Center: Flight Equations with Drag
sources.usage: Terminal velocity as the speed where weight and drag balance.

sources.title: NOAA World Ocean Atlas density data notes
sources.usage: Seawater density depends on temperature, salinity, and pressure; keeps ocean-density assumptions explicit.

sources.title: FG-06 committed near-realism calibration evidence
sources.usage: Existing accepted bands for impact, splash, float settling, leak sensitivity, and terminal speed.

sources.title: FG-09 solver architecture decision evidence
sources.usage: Selected hybrid solver path that future reference packets must calibrate.

cases.title: Concrete cube water-entry speed from 8 m

measurements.metric: water entry speed compared with vacuum free-fall
measurements.uncertainty: Allows up to 12% speed loss from air drag and numerical integration, with no overspeed above sqrt(2gh).

cases.title: Fresh-water ice block static draft in calm seawater

measurements.metric: floating submerged fraction equals object density divided by water density
measurements.uncertainty: Tolerance allows shape discretization and seawater-density assumption drift.

cases.title: Closed-cell foam block settles near hydrostatic equilibrium after a drop

measurements.metric: absolute draft error after damped settling
measurements.uncertainty: Settling window allows transient waves and radiation damping before accepting final draft.

measurements.metric: remaining buoyancy-force error ratio after damped settling
measurements.uncertainty: Allows 8% residual force error from discrete-time damping and finite settling window.

cases.title: Concrete cube high-Weber splash crown band

measurements.metric: splash crown height relative to ballistic head and object size
measurements.uncertainty: Internal empirical band until measured drop footage is attached; formula is explicit to prevent hidden tuning.

expected.formula: lower = 0.045 * (impactSpeedMps^2 / gravity) + 0.18 * objectHeightM; upper = 0.19 * (impactSpeedMps^2 / gravity) + 0.9 * objectHeightM

cases.title: Leaky sealed drum sink-time sensitivity to leak area

measurements.metric: large leak sink-time ratio versus small leak
measurements.uncertainty: Qualitative orifice-flow sensitivity gate; larger leak must materially shorten sink time.

cases.title: Concrete cube finite underwater terminal velocity

measurements.uncertainty: Engineering band covers drag-coefficient and projected-area approximation for a compact dense body in water.
